how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Simple steps, whether you are looking for work or need help.

workers.title: For workers
workers.step1Text: Sign up with your phone number and add the work you can do.
workers.step2Text: Browse jobs by area, category and wage. Apply in one tap.
workers.step3Text: Confirm when the work is done, record your payment and rate the employer.

employers.title: For employers
employers.step1Text: Tell us about your home, shop or organisation. Our team reviews every employer.
employers.step2Text: Share the work, timings and wage clearly. Every job is checked before it goes live.
employers.step3Text: Accept applicants, confirm completed work and rate your workers.

worker.title: Looking for work?
worker.text: Daily-wage, part-time and short-term jobs from homes, shops, hotels and institutions near you.

employer.title: Need a helping hand?
employer.text: Find reliable local workers for a few hours, a day or a few weeks.

footer.safety1: Never pay anyone to get a job.
footer.safety2: {{appName}} records wage payments but does not process or guarantee them.
footer.safety3: Report anything suspicious — our team reviews every report.
